findings.problem: lineRefundableValue used in the per-line remaining formula is only defined implicitly through the §5.4 allocation; it is not restated in one place next to §5.2.
findings.fix: Add a one-line definition `lineRefundableValue(L) = round(lineNetAfterDisc(L)) + lineTax(L)` beside §5.2 so the per-line remaining and the §5.4 allocation visibly share one formula. Readability only; the math is already unambiguous.

findings.problem: invoice_refunds.branch_id is `on delete set null` but RLS requires `auth_branch_visible(branch_id)`; behavior of `auth_branch_visible(null)` after a branch deletion is unstated.
findings.fix: State that `auth_branch_visible` treats null as org-wide-visible (matching the lead_deals pattern this design mirrors) or that invoice-branch deletion is not expected for finalized invoices. Mirrors existing table behavior; not a blocker.
